label: Food Warehouse
description: Prepare delivery orders for 8 cities: discover creator and destination data from SQLite, generate SHA1 signatures, create and populate one order per city.

steps.label: Fetch API help
steps.detail: Call tool=help to understand the warehouse API surface

steps.label: Load city requirements
steps.detail: Download food4cities.json — lists goods and quantities needed by each of the 8 cities

steps.label: DB discovery
steps.detail: Query SQLite (show tables + select *) to find creator ID and city destination codes

steps.label: Reset state
steps.detail: Call tool=reset to clear any previous orders and start from a clean slate

steps.label: Create & fill orders
steps.detail: Per city: generate SHA1 signature → create order → batch-append all required items

steps.label: Verify & get flag
steps.detail: Call tool=done — hub validates all orders match city requirements and returns the flag
